about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Nathaniel Moran

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FOSTERING THE FUTURE ACT
statements.title: FOSTERING THE FUTURE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 7432, the Fostering the Future Act.

At a recent Committee on Ways and Means roundtable with First Lady Melania Trump focused on foster care, I had the privilege of hearing from Jayden Martinez, a student at Stephen F. Austin State University who came out of the foster care system.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TAXPAYER DUE PROCESS ENHANCEMENT ACT
statements.title: TAXPAYER DUE PROCESS ENHANCEMENT ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 6506, the Taxpayer Due Process Enhancement Act, bipartisan legislation introduced alongside my colleague Congresswoman Terri Sewell to strengthen procedural protections for the American taxpayer.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to stand with the taxpayers today and support H.R. 6506.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CRIME VICTIMS FUND STABILIZATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: CRIME VICTIMS FUND STABILIZATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Over the past 2 years alone, False Claims Act settlements have totaled nearly $5 billion, and after defrauded agencies and whistleblowers are made whole, remaining funds currently sit unused.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 909, the Crime Victims Fund Stabilization Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to strongly support this commonsense legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
statements.title: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
sentences: It is fiscally irresponsible and fails to address the waste, fraud, and abuse of ObamaCare while ignoring the real problems in our healthcare system and ignoring the fact that these temporary COVID-era enhanced subsidies have done nothing but pad the profits of big insurance companies and drive up the very premiums that they purport to reduce.
First, ObamaCare has yet to deliver on the promises made to Americans over a decade ago.
Since the ACA was enacted, premiums have increased by roughly 80 percent.
It is important to note that these premium tax credits are sent directly to insurance companies, not the taxpayers, and it is no secret why.

The ACA was written by insurance companies to benefit insurance companies, and it has served to drive up the stock price for those insurance companies by more than 1,000 percent since the ACA came into existence.

Let's not forget that today's proposed extension of these pandemic- era tax credits only relates to the 7 percent of Americans who are actually enrolled in the ACA, not the other 93 percent of Americans who are not participants in the failed ACA exchange.
Yet, the Democrats want to pour more money into a failing ACA program at a cost of $400 billion.

The ACA is just another example of this, and we should not spend more money to prop up a failing program, certainly not a COVID- era, temporary program that they put in place and they, the Democrats, set to expire this year.
Mr. Speaker, that is why I rise today in opposition to this Democratic discharge petition.
This has to end, and I urge my colleagues to oppose this measure.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TAX COURT IMPROVEMENT ACT
statements.title: TAX COURT IMPROVEMENT ACT
sentences: Article III judges already have statutory recusal rules.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of the Tax Court Improvement Act.

I urge my colleagues to vote for the Tax Court Improvement Act to help strengthen a court process that plays a vital role in protecting our taxpayers' rights and ensuring accountability of the IRS within our tax system.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: It is our chance to put working families, small businesses, and communities back at the center of our economic future.
Mr. Speaker, today, I rise in strong support of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO DOLLARS TO UYGHUR FORCED LABOR ACT
statements.title: NO DOLLARS TO UYGHUR FORCED LABOR ACT
sentences: America, known on the international stage as a beacon of freedom and liberty, must not be complicit in the Chinese Communist Party's genocide and oppression of the Uyghur people.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of the No Dollars to Uyghur Forced Labor Act.

Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this critical legislation that would prohibit United States State Department contracts with companies tied to forced labor in the Xinjiang region of China.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PANDEMIC UNEMPLOYMENT FRAUD ENFORCEMENT ACT
statements.title: PANDEMIC UNEMPLOYMENT FRAUD ENFORCEMENT ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 1156, the Pandemic Unemployment Fraud Enforcement Act, introduced by our chairman, Jason Smith.
We cannot allow this to happen, and we must make best efforts to recover these stolen funds.

With the statute of limitations expiring at the end of March for federal pandemic unemployment insurance programs, we support an extension as proposed in H.R. 1156 to ensure that both criminal prosecutions and civil enforcement can continue uninterrupted.
As a proud cosponsor of this legislation, I strongly urge my colleagues to stand in support of the American taxpayer and stand in support of passage of this important piece of legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNITED STATES-TAIWAN EXPEDITED DOUBLE-TAX RELIEF ACT
statements.title: UNITED STATES-TAIWAN EXPEDITED DOUBLE-TAX RELIEF ACT
sentences: Taiwanese companies in America, including those in critical semiconductor sectors, face double tax burdens due to the lack of a U.S.-Taiwan tax agreement.
It strengthens our economic alliance with Taiwan, ensuring a reliable supply chain for semiconductors and reducing dependence on China and our adversaries.
Today's bipartisan bill equips us to expand cross-border investment, safeguard critical supply chains, and push back against China's growing influence.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of the United States-Taiwan Expedited Double-Tax Relief Act.
Without this legislation, we will risk alienating Taiwan, one of our strongest partners in the Indo-Pacific region.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues in Congress to support this vital legislation to do just that.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING THE RIGHTS AND SAFETY OF WOMEN
statements.title: PROTECTING THE RIGHTS AND SAFETY OF WOMEN
sentences: By passing legislation such as Congressman Greg Steube's Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, Congressman Mike Collins' Laken Riley Act, and Congresswoman Nancy Mace's Preventing Violence Against Women by Illegal Aliens Act, we address significant lapses in our justice, legal, and educational systems, and we push back against a radical left agenda that leaves our society in moral tatters.
